user.title: Add a phone
user.description: Name the phone that runs Wirid, e.g. the owner's name. Each phone gets its own device and its own address.

person.title: Who uses this phone?
person.description: Link {phone} to a person, so the shared Wirid dashboard shows them their own stats. You can change this later.

takeover.title: Take over the old sensors
takeover.description:
Found {count} Wirid sensors from the earlier YAML setup. Take them over to keep their history?

**Take over** gives this phone their entity IDs (for example `sensor.wirid_today_total`), so their history continues.

**Start fresh** leaves the old sensors alone. This phone's sensors then get IDs ending in `_2` (for example `sensor.wirid_today_total_2`), and their history starts empty.

done.title: Phone added
done.description:
Copy this address into Wirid on the phone: Settings → Home Assistant → paste it, then turn sending on.

`{url}`

Keep it private: anyone with the address can send stats to this phone's sensors. You can show it again, or replace it, from this integration's options.

error.name_required: Enter a name for the phone.
error.yaml_still_loaded: The old Wirid template sensors are still loaded. Remove the Wirid block from `configuration.yaml`, restart Home Assistant, then add the phone again.

person.title: Who uses this phone?
person.description: Link {phone} to a person. The device and its entity IDs stay the same.

address.title: Phone address
address.description:
Copy this address into Wirid on the phone: Settings → Home Assistant.

`{url}`

new_address.title: Make a new address
new_address.description: Give {phone} a new address, for a lost or shared phone. The old address stops working at once, so paste the new one into Wirid afterwards. Its sensors and history stay.
